results.title: A $1 charge broke my trust in chat support
results.content:
The agent answered as if the answer had been there all along, but my trust was broken. Not only in the chat, but also in the retailer. I am sure things are better now, but you bet I think twice before buying anything from them that might need support.

Better customer service isn’t just about setting up an automation flow. In this story, a few things went wrong: the bot couldn’t resolve a simple billing question, the agent didn’t get the context I already shared, and the bot didn’t even send me to the right agent in the first place. [...] Not knowing if it was a person or a bot on the other side, I explained my situation. It turned out to be a bot that first, misunderstood what I was asking, and then, passed me on to an agent because it couldn’t answer my question.

 “Hi, I am [agent name], how can I help you today?”

I explained my situation again. Turned out, this agent didn’t deal with billing. I was passed on to yet another agent. In the same cheerful way, the agent asked what I needed help with, again.

By now, I was beyond annoyed. It was a one-dollar charge, but I had wasted 15 minutes on this chat, explaining my situation for the third time.

 “Oh. That’s just a test charge for the credit card. It will be refunded in a few hours.” [...] A $1 charge broke my trust in chat support

# A $1 charge broke my trust in chat support

ASAPP

### ASAPP

#### AI-native® contact center. Give your customers more than conversation—give them fast, efficient resolutions.

An experience with a trillion-dollar retailer’s chat scarred me for life.

Two years ago, I’d just joined ASAPP and was using my corporate business card to sign up for a free trial of its membership so I could ship something overnight. But, a mysterious charge of a dollar showed up even though I didn't get any notification. I went to its chat immediately.
